name: Foreign Exchange Terms 37
definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

ToAmount.name: To Amount
ToAmount.definition: Cash amount resulting from a foreign exchange trade.

FromAmount.name: From Amount
FromAmount.definition: Cash amount for which a foreign exchange is required.

UnitCurrency.name: Unit Currency
UnitCurrency.definition: Currency from which the quoted currency is converted in an exchange rate calculation.|1 x <UnitCcy> = <XchgRate> x <QtdCcy>.

QuotedCurrency.name: Quoted Currency
QuotedCurrency.definition: Currency into which the unit currency is converted in an exchange rate calculation.|1 x <UnitCcy> = <XchgRate> x <QtdCcy>.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Factor used for the conversion of an amount from one currency into another. This reflects that amount of the quoted currency that can be purchased with one unit of the unit currency, as follows: |1 x CUR1 = nnn x CUR2, |where: |CUR1 is the unit currency |CUR2 is the quoted currency |nnn is the exchange rate.|1 x <UnitCcy> = <XchgRate> x <QtdCcy>.

QuotationDate.name: Quotation Date
QuotationDate.definition: Date and time at which an exchange rate is quoted.

QuotingInstitution.name: Quoting Institution
QuotingInstitution.definition: Party that proposes the foreign exchange rate.
